findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so objects such as the customer master spreadsheet are not guaranteed to be encrypted at rest with an explicitly configured S3 encryption policy.
The financials bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving financial data without an explicitly enforced encryption-at-rest control.
The operations bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so stored operational data is not protected by an explicitly configured encryption-at-rest policy.
The data-science bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving its stored data without explicitly enforced encryption at rest.
